name: mba Management;leadershp and Decision Sciences
description:
? Earn While You Learn – Earn a competitive salary not less than the minimum hourly wage, currently at $16.9 in Los Angeles, translating to a monthly income of approximately $3,000.
?CareerConnect Academy - provides job placement assistance to the students in our hotel program at no additional cost. In 2024 and 2025, 90% of our students received job offers within two months of arriving on campus.

? The Highest Standard Accreditation – Long-established WASC accreditation (since 1977). The same accreditation organisation for UCLA and UC Berkeley. 
? Hybrid Class: Students only need to attend on-campus class once every 2 months. The rest of the classes are remote, with live classes on Zoom.
? Extension of Status- In anticipation of upcoming changes to the U.S. student visa policy beginning in Fall 2026, EduConnect USA has established a dedicated support team to guide our students and partner agents through the preparation process for the Extension of Status, ensuring clarity, compliance, and timely assistance.
